beliefs: f removes all whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines) from the input [E1: ' '->'', E14: 'a\tb'->'cb', 'a\nb'->'cb', '\t'->'', ' \t '->'']
f shifts only the first character of the whitespace-stripped string forward by 2 in the alphabet, wrapping at the end [E1: 'a'->'c'; E4: 'abc'->'cbc'; E14: '\ta'->'c', '\tA'->'C']
All characters after the first pass through unchanged [E4: 'ab'->'cb', 'abab'->'cbab'; E14: 'a\tb'->'cb', 'a b\tc'->'cbc']
Digits and punctuation pass through unchanged, and a non-letter first character is not shifted [E1: '123'->'123', '!@#'->'!@#'; E11: '1a'->'1a', '!z'->'!z']
The empty string (or all-whitespace string) maps to the empty string [E1: ''->''; E14: '\t'->'', ' \t '->'']
Case is preserved on the shifted first letter [E1: 'A'->'C', 'ABC'->'CBC'; E14: '\tA'->'C']
notes: E14 shows tabs and newlines are stripped like spaces, not just ordinary spaces. Changed the strip from replace(' ','') to removing all whitespace characters.
